title: Playboy Magazine March 1981 Complete w/ Centerfold Twins Issue James Garner
conditionDescription: Vintage 1981 issue. Covers bright. Rubbing and white wear along the spine edge of the front cover (see photo 2), light corner wear; no tears. Complete with centerfold. See photos.
descriptionText:
Playboy magazine, March 1981 issue, original $2.50 cover price. Complete with centerfold.

Cover: Twins - an irresistible survey of saucy sisters. Also: an interview with James Garner; the worst prison riot in history; a pool player's course in trick shots; life insurance; the latest on rainwear, wrist watches, Scotch, darts and auto leasing.

Back cover: Kool Milds cigarette ad.

Adult collectible - sold to buyers 18+ only. See photos for condition. Ships in a plain, protective mailer.
